question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List the names of all genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: What are the first and last names of the customers from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: Show the names and lengths in milliseconds of the 5 longest tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023'

question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: What are the first and last names of the employees whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: How many different countries do the customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer

question: List the names of all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many albums are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album

question: How many tracks cost more than 0.99?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99

question: What is the largest invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many customers have no company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: What is the earliest hire date among the employees?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(HireDate) FROM Employee

question: What are the titles of all albums by AC/DC?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks does each genre have? Show the genre name and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending? Show first name, last name and total spent.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total revenue for each year? Show the year and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY yr

question: How many customers does each support representative have? Show the representative's first name, last name and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which tracks are in the playlist named 'Grunge'? Show the track names.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: Which genres have more than 100 tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId HAVING n > 100

question: List each album by Iron Maiden with its number of tracks. Show the album title and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden' GROUP BY al.AlbumId

question: Which employees report to Nancy Edwards? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

question: What is the total amount spent by customers from each country? Show the country and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country

question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much has the customer Luis Rojas spent in total?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Luis' AND c.LastName = 'Rojas'

question: How many tracks does the artist Metallica have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Metallica'

question: Who is the best-selling artist by revenue? Show the artist name and the total revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS rev FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 genres by total revenue? Show the genre name and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS rev FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which sales support employee's customers generated the most revenue? Show the employee's first name, last name and the total revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS rev FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have bought at least one Jazz track? Show their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: What percentage of the total revenue comes from invoices billed to the USA? Round to 2 decimal places.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA') / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice), 2)

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Show the album title and the track count.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING n > 20

question: Which playlists contain at least one track by AC/DC? Show the playlist names without duplicates.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Who are the top 2 customers by spending on Rock tracks? Show first name, last name and the amount spent.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS s FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 2
